constraint_decided_it: E8 Acquisition scope note: 'This class comprises transfers of legal ownership...' and 'The CIDOC CRM therefore models legal ownership (E8 Acquisition) and physical custody (E10 Transfer of Custody) separately.' The 2010 step is a formal donation, i.e. a transfer of title, so it requires an E8 alongside the E10; A adds it and correctly withholds it from the 1988 deposit, B lists E8 as a rejected alternative on the false ground that the case states no ownership transfer.
better_modelling: Three instances of E10 Transfer of Custody (1934, 1988, 2010), each with P28 custody surrendered by / P29 custody received by (E10 -> E39), P30 transferred custody of the ledgers (E10 -> E18, quantified necessary) and P4 has time-span; the ledgers as an E78 Curated Holding or E22 (both subclasses of E18). The 2010 donation additionally an E8 Acquisition with P23 transferred title from the county record office and P22 transferred title to the archive, since 'deposited' (1988) leaves title untouched while 'donated' (2010) does not. Each signed handover note as an E31 Document with P70 documents (E31 -> E1) pointing at its E10. P49/P50 (E18 -> E39) remain available as declared shortcuts of the P30i/E10/P28-or-P29 path but cannot replace it. A has the E8 half and misses the E31/P70 half; B has the E31/P70 half and denies the E8.
reasoning: Both reach the same core answer and both get the E10 property signature right against declared domains and ranges (P28/P29 E10->E39, P30 E10->E18 and quantified necessary, P70 E31->E1), so neither can be faulted there. B is wrong on the 2010 step: it explicitly rejects E8 Acquisition because the case supposedly describes 'not stated ownership transfers', but the case says the ledgers were formally donated, and E8's scope note plus the E10 scope note's own accession passage make ownership and custody separate, separately recorded transfers. A is unsupported on citation: its Monotonicity quote verifies verbatim at crm732#s0058 and its t1632/Issue 616 characterisation matches the register's closed outcome (FOL for P50/P52/P55 inconsistent with the 'if and only if' scope notes), but it puts in quotation marks an E10 scope note sentence, 'the legal responsibility for the physical custody... may differ from... physical possession', that the scope note does not contain -- 'may differ from' appears nowhere in E10. B's Issue 475 / t1394 attribution for the E10 scope-note rework does check out.
